questions.question: It was only when I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of learning a foreign language.
options: I hadn't finished my degree yet
I wouldn't have been able to learn a foreign language
I would not have known its importance
I could have learned it earlier
questions.answer: I hadn't finished my degree yet

questions.question: The manager, who was known for his exceptional leadership skills, decided to restructure the company.
options: Although he was a good leader
Because of his excellent management style
However, it didn't affect the employees
In spite of his poor communication skills
questions.answer: Because of his excellent management style

questions.question: Unless I had studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
options: Had I not studied hard, I would have failed
If I hadn't studied so much, I might have succeeded
I didn't study enough to pass
Only if I had studied more would I have succeeded
questions.answer: Had I not studied hard, I would have failed

questions.question: The new policy, which was supposed to reduce carbon emissions, has been met with resistance from environmental groups.
options: Although it's been implemented recently
However, its effectiveness is still unclear
In spite of the opposition, it will be enforced
Since it's been widely accepted
questions.answer: However, its effectiveness is still unclear

questions.question: It is essential that students are given adequate support to succeed in their academic pursuits.
options: Unless they receive proper guidance
Only if they have the right resources
Provided they work hard enough
Supposing they have sufficient motivation
